Clean cached Web Soil Survey ZIP archives

Source: R/WSS_cache.R
clear_WSS_cache.Rd

Clean cached Web Soil Survey ZIP archives stored by downloadSSURGO(). By default, this will clear the entire cache unless filtered by arguments.

Usage

clear_WSS_cache(
  areasymbols = NULL,
  fiscal_year = NULL,
  db = c("SSURGO", "STATSGO"),
  pattern = NULL,
  latest_only = FALSE,
  cache_dir = NULL
)

Arguments

areasymbols

character. Optional areasymbol filter.

fiscal_year

character or integer. Optional fiscal year filter such as "FY26".

db

character. One or more of "SSURGO" or "STATSGO". Defaults to both.

pattern

character. Optional regular expression used to filter cached ZIP filenames.

latest_only

logical. If TRUE, preserves the most recent ZIP for each area/fiscal year and deletes only outdated/orphaned ones. Default: FALSE.

cache_dir

character. Optional cache root. Defaults to the soilDB WSS cache.

Value

The removed file paths are returned invisibly.
